verification.STONK_SAFE_LAUNCHPAD_*: Verified source StonkSafeLaunchpadV2 (solc v0.8.24) on robinhoodchain.blockscout.com; one pad per quote lane, all 16 sharing one ABI. V2 pads mint the launch token; V3 pads take an external (bring-your-own) token. Every address above was confirmed on-chain on 2026-08-28 by reading quote() and matching it to the lane it is filed under -- the check that caught a transcription slip in the USDG V2 address. Live launch counts then: V2 WETH 199, STONK 62, GME 35, SPCX 10, AAPL 9, USDG 8, NVDA 4, USO 2; V3 WETH 1 and the rest 0 (fresh, so launchCount is NOT a usable identity signal for the V3 pads). Live params on every pad: launchFeeWei() == 0, creatorFeeBps() == 1650, protocolFeeBps() == 1650, lpFeeBps() == 5000. There is NO WOOD lane and no permissionless way to add one -- a StonkBrokers launch pairs against WETH, STONKBROKER, USDG or a stock token.
verification.SAFE_LAUNCH_LENS_V2: Verified source SafeLaunchLensV2 (solc v0.8.24); 13007 bytes of code. All reads take the pad as their first argument. priceWei(WETH_V2_PAD, 1) answered 39847682795 on 2026-08-28, i.e. it prices a real launch on a real pad. Curve math MUST be read through this lens rather than reimplemented -- the tax schedule changes every minute.
